campaign-01.objective: Get the marble to the finish.

campaign-02.objective: Get the marble around the corner to the finish.
campaign-02.placing: R rotates. Tab chooses another attachment.

campaign-03.objective: Get the marble to the lower finish.
campaign-03.placing: Attach to the high track. Snapping sets the height.

campaign-04.objective: Get the marble up the slope.
campaign-04.begin: Select the fan to adjust its airflow.
campaign-04.selected: Enable airflow and adjust its power.

campaign-05.objective: Get the marble past the paddle.
campaign-05.begin: Select the paddle to change its speed.

campaign-06.objective: Get the marble to the upper finish.
campaign-06.placing: Connect its inlet to the lower track.

campaign-07.objective: Get the marble through the gate.
campaign-07.begin: Select the gate to adjust its opening time.
campaign-07.selected: Timed opening releases the waiting marble.

campaign-08.objective: Get the marble to the right-hand finish.
campaign-08.begin: Select the diverter to change its route.
campaign-08.selected: Choose which branch the diverter sends marbles along.

campaign-09.objective: Get the marble through the gate to the finish.
campaign-09.begin: Select the sensor to connect an event.
campaign-09.selected: Connect Entered to the gate’s Open action.

campaign-10.objective: Get the marble to the upper finish.
campaign-10.begin: Build the route, then connect the mechanism events.
campaign-10.placing: Connect the elevator inlet to the lower track.
